question: Where can I find a restaurant within 160 kilometers toward the west of Lincoln Park Zoo, Manitowoc, WI?
sql: SELECT p.poi_name, p.addr_city, p.addr_state FROM pois AS p WHERE p.amenity = 'restaurant' AND ST_DWithin( p.geometry::geography, ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Lincoln Park Zoo%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Manitowoc%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%WI%' LIMIT 1 )::geography, 160 * 1000 -- 160 kilometers in meters ) AND degrees(ST_Azimuth( ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Lincoln Park Zoo%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Manitowoc%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%WI%' LIMIT 1 ), p.geometry )) BETWEEN 247.5 AND 292.5;
